answer_1.quote: We first evaluate our response generation method according to the following desiderata: (1) the generated responses improve diversity of output; (2) the generated responses are engaging, interesting, and relevant given the previous conversation; (3) the generated responses are controllable...

answer_2.quote: We use several methods to measure the diversity of the generated outputs... We compute the mean percentage of unigrams and bigrams... We also report the mean ENTR score... We report widely-used n-gram-based similarity metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR, as well as the cosine similarity between contextualized embeddings...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation of 100 randomly sampled examples on two metrics associated with response quality... Annotators are tasked to make a pairwise comparison between responses from a pair of generation methods... We collected annotations comparing the two baseline methods; ... we then use the "winning" baseline as a comparison for each proposed method.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare pairs of responses and judge which is more engaging and which is more relevant to the dialogue context.
